description: Median sale price of the dwellings sold in the latest reported quarter in NSW, with the quartiles, the number of sales and the change on a year before, by postcode or council and by dwelling type - all dwellings, non_strata (separate houses) and strata (units, town houses, villas). From the NSW Department of Communities and Justice's Rent and Sales Report (CC BY 4.0). Medians of homes sold: not asking prices, not valuations, and never what any one home sold for or is worth. A line marked UNUSUAL was set by a few very large sales - say so, and do not quote it as a going price. A total noted as mostly a marked row's sales may be moved by them - say that, and no more. A line with any other mark or note: do not quote it as a going price, and claim nothing about why. Always name the dwelling type, the quarter and the source line, and repeat the limits. With no area or council it gives the state's own figures.

area.description: A four-digit NSW postcode (a suburb name returns its postcodes to try)

council.description: An NSW council, or part of its name

dwelling_type.description: total, non_strata (houses) or strata (units, town houses, villas); leave out for all three

name: nsw_sale_prices
title: NSW median sale prices by postcode or council
